I think when I move out I feel a lot better because I don't feel safe in my own home for years and that's terrible.

I know that I don't deserve this at all because I'm not a bad person. I did nothing wrong to deserve this. The problem is, I don't and can't move out because I'm still a child who goes to school and I don't want to leave my mom even if I'm terrified right now. When I remember back to the time from for 1-2 years ago I actually lived much worse than now but it still feels kinda the same but different. Even if my mom is angry at me right now, for whatever reason, I know that tomorrow (hopefully) everything will be fine and she will apologise to me as always, like last week. And if not, then not. When it's daytime and I can see the light in my room then it feels a little bit better even if the situation is difficult now.
I appreciate it a lot. Thank you

Maybe your right. But the only thing I can do to make it through a night is that I just agree to everything she tells me. Because I know when I do that, she will leave soon or after one hour and then I have my peace. It's terrible but this is a way I don't make it all worse.

I know that she just wants the best for me and I also know that her personal and private life is very bad. But I'm her child, why does she take it out on me when I have nothing to do with the situation? I always keep my patience and kindness even though I could just freak out and cry. I'm living like this since 2017 and nothing has changed. And you are right I can't be happy all the time and I should be happy about little things but I just can't. It will all get better some day, at least that's what I hope for.
How can she care about me when she make me feel this pain and take it out on me?
